messages.subject: patched generator local var declarations
parts:
Stan should be generating proper local vector
and matrix and array declarations.

I'm still not auto-initializing auto-dif variables
to zero because it adds to the auto-dif stack and
slows things down. So if a program attempts to use
a transformed parameter before it's assigned a value,
Stan will crash. Using a transformed data parameter
before it's defined will just have undefined behavior,
just like in C++ itself. I could change this default
behavior.

So this Stan code:

derived parameters {
double a;
double b[1];
double c[1,2];

vector(2) aa;
vector(2) bb[3];
vector(2) cc[3,4];

matrix(2,3) aaa;
matrix(2,3) bbb[4];
matrix(2,3) ccc[4,5];

STATEMENTS
}

generates the following C++:

using std::vector;
...

typedef Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,1> vector_d;
typedef Eigen::Matrix<double,1,Eigen::Dynamic> row_vector_d;
typedef Eigen::Matrix<double,Eigen::Dynamic,Eigen::Dynamic> matrix_d;

...

// write transformed parameters
double a;
vector<double> b(1);
vector<vector<double> > c(1,vector<double>(2));
vector_d aa(vector_d(2));
vector<vector_d> bb(3,vector_d(2));
vector<vector<vector_d> > cc(3,vector<vector_d>(4,vector_d(2)));
matrix_d aaa(matrix_d(2,3));
vector<matrix_d> bbb(4,matrix_d(2,3));
vector<vector<matrix_d> > ccc(4,vector<matrix_d>(5,matrix_d(2,3)));

STATEMENTS'

- Bob
